# Temple Scroll Column 38 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Temple Scroll Column 38 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 38:1 — "unclean" vs. "impure" — tame' rendering consistency

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "unclean skin" | Consistent with project convention for tame' |
| LOGOS | "impure skin" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "unclean animal skin" | Adds "animal" for clarity |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET rendering: "unclean skin." Consistent with the project convention of rendering tame' as "unclean."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 38:2 — "died of itself" vs. "died naturally" vs. "died on its own" — nevelah rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "died of itself" | Traditional rendering of nevelah concept |
| LOGOS | "died naturally" | Modern euphemism |
| PNEUMA | "died on its own" | Colloquial equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET rendering: "died of itself." This is the traditional biblical phrasing (cf. Deuteronomy 14:21) and should be preserved.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 38:3 — "cities" vs. "towns" — 'arim rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "cities" | Standard rendering of 'arim in biblical English |
| LOGOS | "towns" | Acknowledges that most ancient Israelite settlements were small |
| PNEUMA | "towns" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET rendering: "cities." The Hebrew 'arim is conventionally rendered "cities" in English Bible translation, regardless of actual settlement size.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 38:6 — "make" vs. "create" — 'asah rendering in purity context

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "make any uncleanness" | Literal 'asah |
| LOGOS | "create any impurity" | Formal variant |
| PNEUMA | "create any source of impurity" | Adds "source of" for clarity |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET rendering: "make any uncleanness." Literal and consistent with 'asah rendering throughout.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 38:13 — "offer" vs. "present" vs. "sacrifice" — hiqriv rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "offer them upon the altar" | Traditional sacrificial language |
| LOGOS | "present them upon the altar" | Formal variant |
| PNEUMA | "sacrifice them on the altar" | Direct verb implying slaughter |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET rendering: "offer them upon the altar." The Hebrew hiqriv means "to bring near/offer" and does not itself denote slaughter.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---
